0.long_answer: Epidermal nevus syndrome is considered a neurocutaneous syndrome because it is associated with abnormalities of the central nervous system (CNS). Patients with this condition can exhibit neurological symptoms such as seizures, cognitive impairment, developmental delays, and structural brain abnormalities (for example, hemimegalencephaly and ipsilateral gyral malformations). These neurological issues underscore the involvement of the CNS rather than peripheral parts of the nervous system.
